⛔ **16** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/pages.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `created_at (literal, 39 pages)`, `organization_id (literal, 38 pages)`
- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **56** of **208** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **148** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3dfd02d0e764224d37973c01646bd498370525e3` — the merge of head `9573871084ddd8e1b72193a39ee6529df0e64af9` into base `1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

```sh

git fetch origin 3dfd02d0e764224d37973c01646bd498370525e3 && git checkout 3dfd02d0e764224d37973c01646bd498370525e3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c 9573871084ddd8e1b72193a39ee6529df0e64af9 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c && git merge --no-ff 9573871084ddd8e1b72193a39ee6529df0e64af9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c
```

</details>

> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than

> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1e8e5296f31742a614395d4267fb7de5172a852c` → pass the list as

No backticks/pipes in `surface`; no `#NNNN` in author-shown fields (pinned).
6. **`RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains `ui/Page:slots.tabs`**; JOIN row in the removal-version pin; liveness note for `slots` lists six slots; `vitest.repo-tests.json` lists the new file. **Right.**
7. **`buildDefaultPageSchema`** loses the `tabs` branch and `BuildPageOptions.slots.tabs`; a `details` slot is always spliced into the synthesized strip. **Right** — Target 2; a stray unparsed `tabs` key is now ignored (pinned), which is the correct runtime answer once the parse refuses it.

No tier behaviour changes for any page that parses.
9. **`@object-ui/types` `PageSlotMap.tabs?: never`**, Studio `SLOT_ORDER` six slots, `slotsToRegions`/`regionsToSlots` round-trip pins moved to `details`. **Right.**

`.changeset/27053-page-slots-tabs-retired.md`: `minor` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@objectstack/skills`; `!` title; **BREAKING** banner with a **FROM → TO.** line, the `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence, the parse answer (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422, the save door, `tsc`), and the HTML-comment marker `adr-0087: registered page-slots-tabs-removed, page-slots-tabs-retired` in the form `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` reads (Check Changeset and the PM dispatch-gates lint are green on the head). **Matches what the diff publishes**: minor-with-BREAKING is the v18-train convention for a retirement (precedent on `main`: `25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits`, `25923-calendar-gantt-flat-keys-handoff`), and the fixed group in `.changeset/config.json` moves spec/skills/console together. - **`premise_still_valid: false` — four in-repo producers authored `slots.tabs`** (the card said none). The dev re-measured on `0f1045bc`, and the PR body says seat 1 confirmed moving all four to `kind: 'full'` with identical behaviour plus the ADR-0133 inline amendment. - **`open_questions[0]` — HotCRM's account page not measured from this session.** Answered by the card's own source line (HotCRM's one slotted page authors `header` + `discussion`, never `tabs`), restated in the D3 `reason`; and a stored row that did carry `tabs` is converted on read by D2 in any case. Nothing outstanding.

ADR-0133's amendment is the inline one-line form the house uses (a block-quoted **Amended (date)** paragraph after the one it corrects), and it is accurate: the mechanism moved, the strip and Members-at-index-0 did not; `identity-auth.json` rev 6 moves the source pin with it.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published spec on `main` and the live consumer: a slotted page's `tabs` slot was a declared capability whose consumer (the synthesizer) delivered it only by dropping every synthesized tab and by opting the page out of the column tiers. The maintainer's keep/narrow/retire ruling retired it; the tree implements the retirement at the spec, not a consumer-side narrowing: the spec refuses, the conversion strips, the synthesizer no longer reads, and the one capability an author still needs (its own strip) is delivered by `kind: 'full'`, which the spec already declares. Nothing declared is taken away without its replacement being real.

**(1) Faithfulness of the four `kind: 'full'` rebuilds — judged against what `buildDefaultPageSchema` composed for each slotted page on `main`.** The synthesizer's order was header → `actions` slot → `alerts` slot → highlights → strip → discussion, no aside (no `showReferenceRail`), no attachments/approvals/history tabs (those live inside `buildDefaultTabs`, which an authored `tabs` slot replaced, so nothing synthesized is lost that the slotted page still had).

- *Header.* Synthesized: `page:header { recordChrome: true, actions: [objectDef.actions filtered to record_header ∪ record_more, deduped by name, declaration order] }`, `actions` omitted when empty. Rebuilt: `page:header` with `properties.actions` as action IDS. `PageHeaderRenderer` (containers.tsx) resolves ids to the object's defs, applies the same location filter (`actionRendersAt record_header | record_more`), capability and `visible` gates, localizes once, dedupes against `RecordContext.headerSystemActions` (Edit/Share/Delete appended by the host for authored and synthesized pages alike), routes `record_more`-only actions to the overflow, and orders by `order` then input index — so identical input order yields the identical header. `recordChrome` defaults to true unless explicitly `false`. Verified lists: `sys_organization` → `set_active_organization, invite_user, leave_organization, rename_organization` (declaration order, lines 134/159/199/238 of the object; `update_organization`/`delete_organization` are list_item only); `sys_user` → the 11 ids in declaration order (`ban_user … delete_my_account`; `enable_two_factor`/`disable_two_factor`/`generate_backup_codes` are record_section only); `sys_approval_request` and `showcase_project` declare no header-location action → bare `{ type: 'page:header' }`, which is what the synthesizer emitted.
- *Highlights.* `sys_organization` authored no `highlights` slot: the synthesizer derived `highlightFields ['name','slug']` minus the title field → `['slug']`, and no `record:path` (no `stageField`, no `status`/`stage`/`state`/`phase` field, no status-typed field on the object — `detectStatusField` answers null). Rebuilt: `record:highlights { fields: ['slug'] }`, no path. The other three authored their `highlights` slot (which replaced the whole strip, path included) and carry the same node.
- *Alerts / actions slot.* `sys_user`'s `record:alert` with its `P` CEL `visibleWhen` envelope is carried verbatim (the envelope-audit control now addresses it at `regions[0].components[N].visibleWhen`); `sys_approval_request`'s `record:approval_decision` sits after the header, before highlights — the synthesizer's slot order.
- *Strip.* A whitespace-insensitive, comment-stripped diff of each page old→new shows the `page:tabs` node unchanged in every item, label map, icon, `record:related_list` columns/sort/limit/filter, the Security tab's `TWO_FACTOR_OFFERED` gate and own-record gate on `sys_user`, the `record:line_items` Tasks grid on the showcase page. The sys_user Security / two-factor / details-tab pins and the approvals page-body pin read the same nodes from `regions[0]`.
- *Discussion.* Present on `sys_organization` and `showcase_project` (synthesized footer), absent on `sys_user` and `sys_approval_request` (their `discussion: []`); `stripDiscussionNodes` on a feeds-off object applies to both page kinds.
- *Host behaviour keyed on `assignedPage`.* A full page skips the synthesized `historyPage` read (no History tab existed on any of the four), takes the same attachments/approvals fallback panels (read off `renderedPage`), the same `pruneUnregisteredRecordPageObjects`, the same named-page route, and the same `pageColumnsEligible = false` the `tabs` slot produced — tabbed at every width, in the drawer, and on mobile, exactly as before. `RecordMetaFooter` is the view's, not the page's.
- **Should-fix:** the two platform pages' header `actions` arrays are a frozen copy of what the synthesizer read live from the object. No pin holds them equal to the object's `record_header` ∪ `record_more` declarations in declaration order (`sys-organization-rename-action.test.ts` reads the object only; the sys_user pins read the strip). Add one pin per page (ids == declared ids with those locations, in order), so the next header action added to `sys_user` / `sys_organization` cannot silently miss the page.

**(2) D2 honesty.** Disclosed (①.4), idempotent, copy-on-write, order unique, `retiredAfter`/`toMajor` consistent with the tree's label and its sibling at `18.2.0`; `retiredFromLoadPath` pinned both ways (a live author is refused, a stored row is rewritten). The D3 entry tells the operator when `kind: 'full'` is the answer. Coverage boundary (only `stack.pages[]`) is stated and matches every other page conversion in the registry.

**(3) Tombstone and aliases** — ①.1–2: text matches the card's prescription, aliases refuse by name with the same remedy (pinned: tombstone for one component, an array and empty; alias guidance; six live slots parse; a full page with `page:tabs` parses; no `#`, migrate sentence; `@ts-expect-error`; barrel export gone).

**(4) Changeset / ADR-0087 / BREAKING** — ②.

**(5) ADR-0133 amendment and the skills bullet.** The amendment is one line, dated, after the paragraph it corrects, and says exactly what moved and what did not. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` gains one accurate bullet under the `kind` list ("A `slotted` record page has no `tabs` slot: shape the strip with `relatedList` / `relatedList: 'primary'` on the child's reference field, or author `kind: 'full'`") paid for by a same-meaning tightening of the Tailwind-in-`className` warning (the examples `text-[27px]`, `grid-cols-7` and the "compiled over the renderer's source, never over your metadata" rule survive); no other `tabs`-slot teaching remains in the file. `ui/content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` drop the row and say how to shape the strip; the plugin-detail README's tier sentence is corrected.

**(6) `RecordDetailView.pageColumnsEligible`** — ①.8: right, and the comment above it says why the arm left.

No must-fix. Two should-fixes: the header-action drift pins (④.1) and the ruling trace on the card (③). One fixture nit (①.11).
